summary: Backend-only testing of VeriFactu pre-submit precheck (blocking) + XML totals with suplidos / no_sujeto (N1). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_verifactu_precheck.py — 10/10 tests PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: precheck() correctly returns Spanish list of problems; verifactu_submit raises 422 with detail prefixed 'No se ha enviado a la AEAT. Corrige esto antes:' and does NOT write to verifactu_log nor mark submitted (verified via Mongo count).

importe_total() = total + irpf − suplidos → ImporteTotal in XML (126.20 for the suplido+recargo case) matches sum(bases+cuotas+recargos) of Desglose. Suplidos (50€) correctly excluded from the XML Desglose while still included in invoice.total (176.20).
cuota_total() = iva_amount + re_amount = CuotaRepercutida+CuotaRecargoEquivalencia in Desglose (26.20 verified).
no_sujeto line produces a DetalleDesglose with CalificacionOperacion N1 and BaseImponibleOimporteNoSujeto = 30.00.

_validate_invoice already blocks creation with invalid client NIF / empty client name — so those precheck branches are only reachable for pre-existing data; tested by DB-level stale-data injection and confirmed they correctly 422.
Minor: in precheck(), f-string uses b.get('base'):.2f which crashes if base is None (unlikely in practice because iva_breakdown is machine-built). Non-blocking.
Minor: AEAT reject email (_vf_reject_notify) only fires in preprod/prod paths; not reachable in simulado as noted by main agent — not tested here (per request).
seed_data_creation: All TEST_VF21 invoices and TEST_ contacts were deleted after the run via Mongo (verified count=0). Company (admin) left with verifactu_enabled=True, verifactu_mode='simulado'; original state was already enabled+simulado in this preview DB, so effectively restored.

Uses pymongo for DB-level stale-data injection because _validate_invoice blocks creation with invalid client NIF or empty name. Preview Mongo at mongodb://localhost:27017/test_database.
